text:
Leah Park: Quick announce — Hosted Toolcall Analytics is GA-ing today. This ships per-tool call counts, sampled traces, cost-attribution estimates, and a new Console -> Toolcalls -> Analytics view. Rollout will be staged by region. :rocket:
Sanjay Rao: congrats! timeline? any SDK changes for customers?
Leah Park: rollout starts 15:30 PT and finishes within ~3h. No SDK mandatory changes. Customers that want sampled traces should add header `X-Redwood-Toolcall-Sample: 1` (or use the SDK opt-in flag).
Becca White: will sampling affect latency or tokens used? ops folks watching?
Tom Alvarez: monitoring knobs added. Watch p50/p95 tool-latency and sampling-error-rate. ops-bot: runbook posted: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/toolcall-analytics-oncall
Leah Park: sampling is async and capped; negligible latency impact. Token billing unchanged for normal usage; sampled trace exports fall under "export-debug" billing if enabled (customers will be prompted).
docs-bot: docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/toolcall-analytics (includes curl + python SDK examples + migration notes)
Sanjay Rao: Dedicated / Private customers? Is this available there?
Leah Park: yes — Dedicated can enable it from Admin -> Feature Flags -> ToolcallAnalytics. Private deployments get the analytics module in the next patch (v1.8.0); see private upgrade notes in docs.
Becca White: ops note: canaries created tc-analytics-canary-1..4. Revert if error rate +5% sustained for 10m.
Tom Alvarez: added alert thresholds to eng-sre dashboards. Also added automated rollback if 10% of sampled traces show malformed payloads.
Sanjay Rao: marketing/customer comms? we should coordinate email + changelog entry.
Leah Park: Product will send an email to accounts and post a public changelog item. Also a short migration guide for customers still using the old "tool-telemetry" header. Deprecation date: 2026-08-15.
Becca White: quick pasteable curl sample for eng channels?
Leah Park: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Toolcall-Sample: 1" \
  -d '{"tool":"search","input":"status"}'
```
Sanjay Rao: thanks — will add to internal onboarding doc. 
Leah Park: final: if you see regressions during rollout, ping @eng-sre and tag the canary key in the alert. Q&A session at 16:30 PT in #product if folks want details. :white_check_mark:
